# Nexley

> A syllabus-aligned study notebook for NSW HSC Year 11-12 students. Notes and
> classwork file against the actual syllabus, marks are recorded with the
> conditions they were sat under (exam marks and open-notes marks are never
> averaged together), and term planning shows which weeks are over-committed
> before they arrive.

Nexley is a free, offline-capable web app (installable as a PWA). It is not a
question bank and does not predict exam topics or provide model answers — it
organises a student's own notes, marks and time against their own syllabus.

## What it does
- Files notes and classwork against the syllabus dot points they cover.
- Records real exam/test marks, grouped by the conditions sat under, and shows
  which dot points marks were actually lost on.
- Spaced review turns a lost mark into a flashcard automatically.
- Term planning shows what is due each of the next eight weeks and flags
  over-commitment as arithmetic, not a guess.
- Works fully offline; sync is opt-in once signed in.

## What it deliberately does not do
- No predicted band or grade, anywhere in the app.
- No shared question bank or model-answer library (a licensing constraint, not
  an oversight).
- No public leaderboard — a comparison ("comp") is joined by code between
  people who chose each other, never browsable or ranked against a cohort.

- [Legal](https://ajspeedy10.github.io/nexley/legal.html) — privacy policy, terms,
